data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 30/1134Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL CONTINUES MOVING NORTHWESTWARD. ...COULD BECOME A MAJOR HURRICANE IN A DAY OR SO... As of 5:00 AM MST Wed Sep 30 the center of Rachel was located near 17.8, -107.6 with movement NW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 979 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 85 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 30/1447Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION NINETEEN-E A LITTLE STRONGER. As of 8:00 AM PDT Wed Sep 30 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 14.3, -128.4 with movement E at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1002 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/1450Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA BECOMES A REMNANT LOW PRESSURE AREA. As of 3:00 PM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.4, -43.6 with movement E at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
